title: The Deep Tracks Channel Counts Down Classic Rock’s Haunted Album Cuts
summary: Halloween is just around the corner, and Deep Tracks on SiriusXM is focusing on Classic Rock’s best Halloween songs!
body_markdown:
Halloween is almost here, and Deep Tracks is digging through classic rock’s darker side for a special Halloween album cut countdown. Now, it’s time for you to vote so we can play your favorites in order!


[Deep Tracks Classic rock album tracks & rarities Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogDeepTracksCountdown)


Then, hear the countdown when it premieres on Deep Tracks (Ch. 308) Friday, October 30 at 5pm ET, 2pm PT. The special will also be available on the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogDeepTracksCountdown) after it airs.


**Directions:** Vote once for up to 15 of your favorites in the poll below. To avoid bias, songs are listed in random order for each individual listener, and there is a write in box if you think of something we didn’t!
